display.purpose: Page greetings only; extrabold, clamp-scaled, balance-wrapped.

headline.purpose: Card heroes — Ego Trap question, page/case-study titles.

label.purpose: Geist Mono. System data only — eyebrows, day codes, timestamps, status chips.

shadows.name: low
shadows.purpose: Cards/panels on hover. Interactivity, not permanent elevation.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Modals, dialogs, hovered library cards lifted off the page.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Cobalt CTA for the single most important action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 38px; padding: 0 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-bg); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px oklch(0.44 0.18 256 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-primary-active); transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action — bordered, transparent, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 28px; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-2); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Course/category tag — surface-raised pill with hairline border.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-full); background: var(--color-surface-raised); color: var(--color-ink-2); font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Prep/completion status — mono uppercase, status-tinted. Shown here in the warning (In Progress) variant; swap to success/error tokens for the other states.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 22px; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-warning-surface); color: var(--color-warning); font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Flat-at-rest content container; hairline border, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Anchoring in Renewal Conversations

Set the right reference point before pricing enters the room.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); background: var(--color-bg); cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 1px 3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.05), 0 2px 12px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.03); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-ink); line-height: 1.35; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink-2); line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Knowledge Oracle Search
components.description: Topbar search field. Focus-within shifts border to cobalt with a soft ring and switches fill to white.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"/></svg><input class="ds-search-input" type="text" placeholder="Ask anything — ROI benchmarks, objection handles, client history…" /><kbd class="ds-kbd">⌘K</kbd></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; height: 34px; padding: 0 0.75rem; border: 1.5px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink-placeholder); cursor: text; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), box-shadow 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.428 0.198 256 / 0.10); background: var(--color-bg); } .ds-search-input { flex: 1; min-width: 0; border: none; background: transparent; outline: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-ink-placeholder); } .ds-kbd { flex-shrink: 0; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-ink-placeholder); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 3px; padding: 1px 5px; }

components.name: Library Tab
components.description: Text tab with an amber underline on the active item — the one place the accent carries navigation.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab ds-tab--active">Courses</button><button class="ds-tab">Case Studies</button><button class="ds-tab">Failure Library</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-subtle); } .ds-tab { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; margin-bottom: -1px; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; font-family: var(--font-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-2); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-tab--active { color: var(--color-ink); font-weight: 600; border-bottom-color: var(--color-accent); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: A professional workspace built around one idea: the best colleague always has the right context ready, never makes you feel judged for not knowing something, and gets you to the answer fast. The system uses tonal restraint as its primary language; space, weight, and subtle warmth do the work other platforms hand to color. Two saturated colors exist and earn their appearances: a cobalt/indigo primary carries interactive UI, and an amber-gold accent is rarer still, reserved for signal moments. It rejects generic-SaaS gray, corporate-LMS density, consumer-edtech gamification, and CRM dashboard overload.
keyCharacteristics: Tonal and spatial, not chromatic and busy
Near-white canvas; a cobalt primary for action and an amber accent for rare signal
Typography-led hierarchy in OKLCH; weight and size carry structure
Responsive motion only: state feedback and grid-row expand/collapse
Content-forward: the UI recedes; what the Champion needs advances
Light and dark themes both meet AA independently via [data-theme="dark"]

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is for action and interactivity; amber is for rare signal. Cobalt may appear on any screen; amber stays ≤10% and marks moments, not chrome. Never interchangeable, never decorative.

rules.name: The Consistent Accent Rule
rules.body: Both saturated colors keep their hue across light and dark mode — lightness shifts for contrast, hue does not.

rules.name: The Weight-First Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is expressed in weight before color. Color on type is reserved for links, interactive labels, and the cobalt/amber signals — never decorative emphasis of static content.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface carries no shadow at rest (the radar front card excepted). Low appears on hover, ambient lifts modals, nothing above that.

dos: Do use weight for hierarchy before color. Cobalt marks action; amber marks rare signal, ≤10% of any screen.
Do write supporting text at true mid-dark (ink-2 or darker) and verify AA 4.5:1, including placeholders.
Do edit colors in globals.css (the CSS variables are the source of truth); tailwind.config.js only references them via var(--…).
Do write borders as border-line / border-line-subtle (the token is line, not border).
Do use text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 and text-wrap: pretty on prose; cap reading content at 65–75ch.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion path.
Do distinguish layers tonally (bg → surface → surface-raised) before adding borders.
Do keep status meaning carried by icon + label, never color alone.
Do use the semantic z-index scale (dropdown → sticky → modal-backdrop → modal → toast → tooltip).
donts: Don't make this look like generic SaaS (Notion, Linear) — neutral-gray minimal everything.
Don't make this a corporate LMS (Workday, SAP) — no blue gradients, table-dense grids, clipart, or 'click Next to continue.'
Don't make this consumer edtech (Duolingo, Coursera) — no streak badges as chrome, confetti palettes, or mascots.
Don't make the Workspace a CRM dashboard (Salesforce, HubSpot) — it's a focused view of right-now, not KPI widgets.
Don't use a border-left/right stripe wider than 1px as an accent. Use a background tint, a leading icon, or a numbered marker.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Emphasis via weight or size.
Don't use the warm-neutral band oklch(L 84–97%, C < 0.06, hue 40–100) as the body background — that's the cream/sand AI default. The canvas is true white.
Don't use numbered section eyebrows (01/02/03) or a tiny uppercase tracked kicker above every heading as default scaffolding.
Don't give every section the same entrance animation — motion fits what it reveals.
